messages:
IncBot: Pager: embeddings-queue-surge.prod-eu-west — firing alerts: embedding-service p95 latency > 1.8s, 5xx rate 12%. Pager to @Maya_P (primary), @Priya_S (secondary). Link: https://alerts.redwood/prod/embeddings

Maya Patel: I'm on it — quick summary: seen spike after 18:22 UTC, correlates with increased batch sizes from recent rollout. Customers impacted: some search/assistant customers in EU and a few in NA (via routing). Not a full outage but high error tail.

Priya Singh: I can take prim/sec swap if you want. current actions?

Maya Patel: Actions in flight:
- scaled embeddings-dedicated pool +2 nodes (provisioning)
- applied temporary rate cap on external customers via quota rule (rule id r-83)
- enabled aggressive batching fallback (lower max_batch_size)
- cache warmup for prefix hits started

Luke Chen: quick note — we rolled model-quant change in eu-west at 17:58, might be related. Suggest hold swap until we validate warmup; if perf doesn't improve, rollback quant tweak.

Maya Patel: Agreed. Priya if you become primary after handoff, please be ready to trigger rollback `deployctl rollback service embeddings eu-west --to=canary-123`.

Priya Singh: ack. I'll watch provisioning and if nodes don't come up in 6m I'll start canary rollback. Also will open a customer comms stub with SRE-CS.

Maya Patel: Runbook pointers: https://intranet.redwood/runbooks/embeddings-throttle
Relevant snippet:
```
# kill switch
deployctl set-flag embeddings.quant-optimize false --region eu-west
# scale
k scale deployment embeddings-dedicated --replicas=6 -n prod-eu-west
```

Luke Chen: Observability notes: prefetched KV hit rate dropped 40% at spike start — suggests cache eviction. Check redis-evictions metric: redis-eu-west.evictions[5m]

Priya Singh: Coverage gap: APAC oncall not overlapping until 02:00 UTC. If this degrades further in APAC we might need to engage cross-region failover. Maya, mark that for next steps.

Maya Patel: Marked. For handoff checklist:
- Primary after me: Priya Singh (confirmed)
- Secondary: Luke Chen
- Pager escalation: OpsLead oncall if >15% 5xx sustained for 10m
- Customer impact: active (partial) — SRE-CS draft started
- Runbook link included
- Actions: watch node scaling, check redis evictions, don't swap model until warmup completes

Priya Singh: Taking over live. I'll post status updates every 10m. FYI :warning: will post when I trigger rollback.

IncBot: Note: page acknowledged by Maya Patel at 18:26 UTC

Maya Patel: handing off — logging out for dinner, Priya you have primary. Ping me if rollback or cross-region failover is needed. :thumbsup:

Priya Singh: Got it. Signing on. I'll update at 18:36 UTC. /end
